about: List markers in the look of their item's first letter on both phones (TextLists.markerStyle): the span in force at the first character of each line's words that is not a space or a tab gives the marker its colour, scale, font, weight and italic (never link, highlight, script or caps); null keeps the box's own look, as does a span that starts after that character. `markers` is each line's marker look in order, only the keys it sets, null for the box's own. Shared row for row by both phones' tests (Android MarkerStyleTest, iOS MarkerStyleTests).

rows.name: a red, larger word at the start of item 2 after spaces
the link and highlight of the same word are not the marker's
a style starting after the first letter is not the marker's
a face, weight and slant, but not a script
a tab before the first letter
